prompt:
Use case: game production prop sprites, not UI icons. Create an original high-definition Taoist chibi hand-painted 8-direction vehicle atlas for an isometric transport simulation. Strict style references are input image 1 (mail) and image 2 (team): jade/teal, warm ivory, restrained fine brass-gold craftsmanship, rounded full shapes, careful hand-painted shading, no photorealism, no plastic gloss or pixel art. Input image 3 is ONLY a heading/layout guide; never reproduce its arrows, cells or text.
OUTPUT: wide 2:1 atlas desired 2048x1024, genuinely transparent alpha. Exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows of equal square cells, one COMPLETE isolated vehicle in each cell. At least 12% transparent padding around each vehicle in every cell. No frame, grid, labels, letters, numbers, watermarks, terrain, background, platform, road, track or ground shadow.
CAMERA: fixed orthographic isometric camera at 30-degree elevation. Same physical dimensions, colors and identity throughout. Vehicle stays upright on its normal wheels/hull/skids; do NOT tilt the camera or rotate the entire picture plane. Change its actual heading around the vertical axis.
MANDATORY EXACT ORDER, left to right:
TOP ROW: 1 N = REAR view, front/nose points straight UP away from viewer; 2 NE = rear-right view, nose points UPPER-RIGHT; 3 E = right-facing profile, nose points RIGHT; 4 SE = front-right view, nose points LOWER-RIGHT.
BOTTOM ROW: 5 S = FRONT view, nose points straight DOWN toward viewer; 6 SW = front-left view, nose points LOWER-LEFT; 7 W = left-facing profile, nose points LEFT; 8 NW = rear-left view, nose points UPPER-LEFT.
True FRONT, BACK, LEFT, RIGHT, and FOUR DIAGONAL views are essential. The rear must not show front face/headlights. Do not repeat the same diagonal 8 times. All bodies centered and fitted to the same logical cell scale, no cropping or overlapping neighboring cells.
SUBJECT: One small rounded steam locomotive: short upright chimney, jade boiler, brass wheels and piston linkage, round gold front lamp, rear cabin with square window. No tender or carriage, no smoke emitted; every facing must show the SAME locomotive, recognizable front lamp versus rear cabin.
